UserProfile.title: Student Account Profile
UserProfile.description: Private student account metadata for OCR Unit R050 Exam Simulation. Strictly isolated to the owning authenticated user.

uid.description: Immutable Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: Student display name shown on exam headers and results.

studentClass.description: Optional school class or tutor group label.

authProvider.description: Immutable sign-in method used when creating the profile.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp of account creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest profile update.

ProgressSnapshot.title: Student Cloud Progress Snapshot
ProgressSnapshot.description: Native Firestore Map storing all OCR Unit R050 revision, exam, flashcard, and studio progress modules for a single student.

ownerId.description: Immutable Firebase Auth UID of the owning student.

modules.description: Native Map of OCR R050 revision modules (examState, flashcards, coachDrafts, papersArchive, officialAttempts, customPapers, ta1Trainer, ta3Simulator, ta4SecurityLab, ta56SystemBuilder, commandDrills, dailyWarmup).

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp of initial sync.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest cloud sync.

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-only private student account profile document keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/users/{userId}/progress/{progressId}.description: Owner-only subcollection containing the single 'snapshot' document with all synced OCR R050 progress modules.
